The additional hostile layers push it toward the lower end of 0.45 or maybe 0.40-0.45. Also note the bathroom restriction explicitly framed in "child protection"/harassment terms — threat-framing by the state (tier 1 state threat-framing).

But positives: no criminalization, no documented police targeting, first police torture conviction (state accountability operating, albeit slowly), court struck anti-equality decree, conversion therapy ban, pride, education curriculum. These keep it out of 0.35 territory? The 0.35 anchors involve police extortion, service refusal at scale with no remedy, ward placement abuse documented. So it must be in [0.40, 0.60). With tier-1 feature and additional negatives (no anti-discrimination recourse, institutional hostility), it sits at the lower part: ~0.42-0.45.
